suites.title: Native browser contract with intercepted API responses — PostgreSQL E2E remains separate

specs.title: ignores a persisted demo persona and requires actual API authentication
keeps a failed login form and retries the same intent before navigating on acknowledgement
accepts a new invitation only after a matching ACK and preserves the result after cache invalidation
requires the invited existing identity and does not offer a password replacement
keeps a reset draft after an invalid ACK and shows completion after authentication changes
retains a dirty profile and its reviewed version across background refresh and resolves conflict explicitly
allows an actual nullable own work phone and saves only after the server profile acknowledgement

suites.title: Native school browser contract — intercepted API, separate from PostgreSQL E2E

specs.title: keeps school edits on a transient read failure and removes the private form on forbidden reads
accepts nullable public contacts and clears dirty state only after a matching profile ACK
opens a school without years and keeps year creation reachable
keeps a reviewed school profile through background refresh and reloads explicitly after conflict
creates a class with class authority alone, retains a wrong ACK and retries one atomic command
shows the year calendar with year authority alone and labels denied class data

suites.title: Native staff browser contracts — intercepted API, separate from PostgreSQL E2E

specs.title: renders denied assignment and history panels without inventing empty data or reading invitations
keeps mixed action scopes and source version through refresh, retains read failures and reloads a role explicitly after conflict
